summary: Frontend-only verification of demo login accounts. Both teacher (guru@cortexia.id) and student (siswa@cortexia.id) with Cortexia123 log in successfully via the auth modal, token is persisted in sessionStorage as 'cortexia-token', role-appropriate home views render without errors, protected /teacher dashboard loads with empty counters (0 profil pembaca, 0 sesi, 0 menit, — ketepatan) as designed, and logout clears the token and returns to the landing page. No console errors, no .error elements on page.

issues: No role-based guard: student users can navigate to /teacher and see the Ruang Guru dashboard shell (data remains empty). Consider role gating if teacher-only views are intended.

action_items: Optional: add role-based guard so student-role users cannot access /teacher (currently RequireAuth checks auth only, not role).
critical_code_review_comments: RequireAuth in /app/frontend/src/components/Auth.jsx only checks authentication, not role. /teacher route is reachable by any authenticated user regardless of role.
App.js and Auth.jsx are heavily single-line minified in source; readability/maintainability is poor, but not a functional issue.
test_credentials: Teacher: guru@cortexia.id / Cortexia123 (role: teacher). Student: siswa@cortexia.id / Cortexia123 (role: student). Confirmed working end-to-end via UI. Documented in /app/memory/test_credentials.md.
seed_data_creation: None. Kept participant data empty by design.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Demo accounts persist in DB. Auth flow: click [data-testid=login-button] -> modal [data-testid=auth-modal] -> fill auth-email/auth-password -> click auth-submit -> user-name appears in header. Token key: sessionStorage 'cortexia-token'. Nav: nav-teacher -> /teacher, nav-progress -> /progress. Logout via [data-testid=logout-button].
